scope_reference_evidence.text_excerpt: This profile covers one manufactured article: unmodified, non-self-adhered, mineral-surfaced fiberglass asphalt roofing supplied in complete solid rolls. Its foreground starts from purchased complete cured glass mat and roofing-grade coating asphalt, includes actual filled-coating preparation and the entire coating/surfacing/cooling/cut/wind/QC route, and ends at the unique first complete quality release. Packing, storage, handling and dispatch remain separate original-cohort service ledgers. It is a transparent technical synthesis from a manufacturing handbook and a real manufacturer terminal, not a claimed single-SKU/factory recipe. `arma-residential-manual-2014`; `tarco-fiberglass-msr`

Exclude shingles and their self-seal/lamination/release-tape system, polymer-modified SBS/APP or polyester membranes, smooth/organic underlayment, bare/uncoated mat/paper, liquid coatings/primers/emulsions, upstream binder extraction/refining as foreground, paving mixes, roof assemblies and installation. An ordinary material/provider/quantity gap remains a collection requirement; an actual incompatible core terminal is a hold. No default composition, plant heat source, emission, coating temperature, line speed, density, lifetime, fire/wind/acoustic rating or certification is supplied. UN CPC3.0 lists 37930 and neighbouring 37940 titles without detailed inclusion/exclusion prose; this narrower semantic boundary is not an accepted mapping. `unsd-cpc3-notes-2025`

en.text_excerpt: | b_pack | service | This ledger spans receipt and actual attachment before or after quality release; each actual packaging operation is assigned once to its recorded manufacturing/cohort-service gate. For each packaging material separately: opening empty + attached WIP/FG + reusable stock + P + I + ER = closing empty + attached WIP/FG + reusable stock + S + EO + W, in consistent measured mass/state. P is separately purchased, I supplier-included ingress, ER external return received, S packaging on gross physical dispatch, EO external return sent, W waste. Internal reuse cancels; P/I whole-article contents and six legs are deduplicated only against other incoming/outgoing terms. Preserve actual new influx and full closing wet mass together. Do not put packaging in Q or buy reused assets again; upstream owner once, no automatic coproduct or credit. | `arma-residential-manual-2014`; `ilcd-detailed-2010` |

findings.summary: The defined exhaustive P/I/ER receipt partition omits a first standalone non-purchased packaging article.
findings.counterexample: Opening stock=0. Receive a first standalone gift/borrow/pool whole packaging article compatible with this actual pool (20 kg measured wet lot), with no paid-goods acquisition, no supplier-accompanied material and no earlier outward event. Retain all 20 kg at closing; no additions/removals, shipment or waste. Old P=I=ER=0 gives left side 0, right side 20 kg. It cannot be invented as an old return or repaired by a moisture/repair residual.
findings.expected_repair: Make actual paid whole-article receipts P (including proven bundled paid goods); make I a disjoint actual first non-purchased receipt, explicitly including borrowed/gift/pool and supplier-included cases that are not P; ER needs the same article earlier outward history. Update headings/cards/protocol fields and normative rules in both languages. Preserve full gross mass, wet stocks, original cohort/H, inherited service and one actual burden owner; no fresh manufacture burden solely because ownership changes.
